data.bio: Samantha Gonzalez is a dedicated mother to her daughter Sylvia Stevens. She works as a marketing professional and balances her career with raising her daughter. Samantha values the relationship she has with Sylvia and works hard to provide for her. She enjoys spending time with her daughter and supporting her interests and activities.
